correctness.rationale: The frozen high-girth theorem is correct, but the frozen local generalization fails for K₁: its two neighborhood conditions are vacuous, yet the displayed one-block partition has no partner. The repaired RESULT.md requires Δ≥1 for the local theorem. For Δ≥2 the intersecting coalition edges give a universal hub via the star/triangle dichotomy. A hub failing total domination requires a neighbor of a single witness in each distinct partner; otherwise all partners must meet a single outside edge, giving at most two. For Δ=1 any graph admitting a coalition partition must be a nonempty matching, and the only TOIDS is the full graph, so exactly two blocks are possible. In the repaired construction V∖N(v) leaves only v undominated, N(v) is independent, and there is at least one singleton neighbor to repair the failure. With δ≥2 and girth≥5, triangles exclude internal edges in N(v), and four-cycles exclude two neighbors there of a vertex outside N[v]. The repaired six-vertex argument gives the valid partition ({0,1,2},{3},{4,5}); four blocks would force a maximum-degree domination witness with one neighbor in each partner, leaving a same-shore degree-two vertex undominated by at least one hub-partner union. The corrected verification notes distinguish visiting all partitions from scoring all of them: line 91 of the unchanged verifier skips leaves no larger than the incumbent, which is sound for the maximum. Complete corrected scientific files are provided in repairs/1.
residual_risks: The frozen verifier and its output were inspected, not rerun. It does not cover the Δ=1 local case; the matching proof does. The independent boundary enumeration and the administrative wording of reproducibility do not substitute for the proof at arbitrary graph order.

value.rationale: The corrected finding is still an exact extremal theorem for a natural unrestricted class: it identifies when a known degree ceiling is achieved in all graphs of minimum degree two and girth at least five, constructs an optimum partition, and exhibits a structural obstruction at girth four. Nonregular and disconnected cases are included. The value is in the sharp construction and broad class, not the minor Δ=1 scope repair or the known cyclic cases.
